details.label: Applicant name
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section C (Applicant): last name and first name.

details.label: Applicant role
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section C: tick 'Owner' or 'Authorized agent of owner'.

details.label: Project type
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section B (Purpose of application): tick the type of work.

details.label: Project description
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section B: 'Description of proposed work'.

details.label: Estimated construction value
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section A: 'Project value est. $'.

details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section I (Declaration of applicant): 'Date'.

details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section I: print your name in the declaration.
